en: Muhammad ibn 'Abd al-A'la al-Qaysi narrated to me, al-Mu'tamir ibn Sulayman al-Taymi narrated to us, from his father, from Raqabah, from Abu Ishaq, from Sa'id ibn Jubayr, who said: It was said to Ibn 'Abbas: "Nawf claims that the Musa who went seeking knowledge was not the Musa of the Children of Israel." He said: "Did you hear him say that, O Sa'id?" I said: "Yes." He said: "Nawf has lied."
